evals.prompt: Adopt this captured upstream skill for useful local use.
evals.expected_output: Canonical Skill Build applies the complete validated package, retaining the original source reference.

evals.prompt: Adopt from previously captured upstream source without fetching it again.
evals.expected_output: Reuse the exact captured source without refetching. Apply a complete package only when the source establishes a useful distinct skill and its required source/license context is sufficient; otherwise return a justified no_skill, needs_core, or blocked result with an actionable reason and no package writes.
expectations: Do not refetch the upstream repository or replay the upstream operational workflow.
Do not manufacture a useful capability or license permission to satisfy a forced package-creation expectation.
Preserve the architecture decision rationale and recovery context in the returned result, including when no package is created.
